curses.name: Get a Melon
curses.description: Before starting another challenge, you must acquire a whole melon of any kind. Keep it with you for the rest of the game. If you have not obtained one within 30 minutes, this curse is cleared and you may continue.

curses.name: Egg Partner
curses.description: Before starting another challenge, you must acquire an egg (real). The egg is now an official team member for the rest of the game. If any team member is abandoned, or the egg suffers any visible crack, you immediately veto your current or next challenge. If you have not obtained an egg within 30 minutes, this curse is cleared and you may continue.

curses.name: Best Friends Forever
curses.description: When you next board a train, choose two other passengers. You may not alight until one of them has left the train, and then only at the first interchange after they do. If you reach the end of the line first, you may alight there.

curses.name: Pub
curses.description: Before starting another challenge, go to a pub and buy one pint of liquid per team member. The team must finish it before leaving.

curses.name: Together Forever
curses.description: For 60 minutes, two team members must link arms. You may change which two, but the linked pair must take part in every challenge. This does not apply at ticket barriers, on escalators or on stairs.

curses.name: Long Neck
curses.description: Your next challenge must be requested at least four interchanges along your declared line from your Anchor. If fewer than four remain, you must go to the last one. This curse ends when you next extend your Body.

curses.name: Short Leash
curses.description: Your next challenge must be requested at the first interchange you reach on your declared line. This curse ends when you next extend your Body.

curses.name: Blind Declaration
curses.description: Declare now, publicly, the line you will board after your current challenge. You are bound to it. If you are not currently attempting a challenge, declare before you request your next one.

curses.name: Stated Intent
curses.description: Announce to all teams the interchange at which you will request your next challenge. You must request it there. This curse ends when you next extend your Body.

curses.name: Backwater
curses.description: Your next Neck may not include any interchange served by more than two lines. Void if every reachable interchange on your declared line breaks this. This curse ends when you next extend your Body.

curses.name: Second Guess
curses.description: The next line you declare may not be the line you arrived on. Void if your interchange is served by only one line.

curses.name: Stairs Only
curses.description: For 60 minutes you may not use escalators or lifts. Where a station offers no stair route (or it is blocked), you must instead wait three minutes before using the escalator or lift.

curses.name: Scenic Route
curses.description: Before requesting your next challenge, walk a full lap around the block containing the station. This applies once.

curses.name: Sightseeing
curses.description: Before requesting your next challenge, visit every street entrance of the interchange you are at. This applies once.

curses.name: No running
curses.description: For 60 minutes you may not run, and the whole team must move at the pace of its slowest member, staying within sight of each other.

curses.name: Front Carriage
curses.description: For 120 minutes you may only board the front carriage of any train. If the front carriage is full or closed, you must wait for the next train.

curses.name: Long Veto
curses.description: Your next veto period is doubled. This applies once, whether the veto is chosen or caused by a failed challenge.

curses.name: No Way Out
curses.description: You may not veto your next challenge pair. If you fail a challenge, the veto period is doubled and this curse is spent

curses.name: Ambition
curses.description: You may only attempt the harder of your two offered challenges. This curse ends when you next extend your Body.

curses.name: Double or Nothing
curses.description: You must complete both of your offered challenges before you may extend your Body. You receive the reward for the harder one.

curses.name: Invisible Hand
curses.description: Every member must keep one hand behind their back during challenge attempts. This curse ends when you next extend your Body.

curses.name: Wrong Hand
curses.description: Members may use only their non-dominant hand during challenge attempts. This curse ends when you next extend your Body.

curses.name: Vow of Silence
curses.description: Members may not speak to one another during challenge attempts. You may still speak to anyone else. This applies to your next two challenges.

curses.name: Understudy
curses.description: Nominate one member now. Only that member may perform any physical action in your next challenge. The rest may advise but not touch anything.

curses.name: Spectator
curses.description: The other teams nominate one of your members. That member may not take part in challenge attempts at all. This applies to your next two challenges.

curses.name: Witness
curses.description: For the rest of the game you must send all other teams a photo of yourselves before entering any station

curses.name: Bouquet
curses.description: Before starting another challenge, acquire a bunch of flowers. They must be visible in every piece of challenge evidence you submit for the rest of the game. If you have not obtained flowers within 30 minutes, this curse is cleared and you may continue.

curses.name: Balloon
curses.description: Acquire an inflated balloon within the next 30 minutes and keep it with you for an hour after that. If it pops or escapes in that hour, you immediately veto your current or next challenge. If you cannot obtain one in 30 minutes, this curse is cleared.

curses.name: Rainy Day
curses.description: For 60 minutes, one member must hold an open umbrella whenever any part of the team is under open sky. The umbrella may not strike anyone or anything.

curses.name: Team Colours
curses.description: Until you next extend your Body, every member must be wearing something visible in the colour of the line you arrived on.

curses.name: Dead Weight
curses.description: For 60 minutes, the team must carry at least one kilogram of additional weight by hand. It may not be set down while you are moving between interchanges.

curses.name: Hat Trick
curses.description: Before starting another challenge, every member must acquire headwear and wear it for the rest of the game. It may not be something a member already had with them. If you have not obtained enough headwear within 30 minutes, this curse is cleared and you may continue.

curses.name: Open Hand
curses.description: Immediately reveal to all teams how many coins you have and what powerups are in your hand.

curses.name: No Signal
curses.description: For 30 minutes you may not use any map or transport app, or look up any route. You may still use your phone for the game bot and for challenges, but try not to look at the map
